theorems.statement: ∀ (E L : ℝ → ℂ), ContinuousOn E (Set.Ioo 1 2) → ContinuousWithinAt L (Set.Ici 1) 1 → L 1 ≠ 0 → (∀ s : ℝ, s ∈ Set.Ioo 1 2 → Complex.exp (E s) = L s) → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε ≤ 1 ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 1 < s → s < 1 + ε → ‖E s‖ ≤ C
